newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortel, BCE Mobile unit in deal.
newsitem.headline: Nortel, BCE Mobile unit in deal.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Monday it signed a three-year, C$400 million deal with Bell Mobility to supply equipment to Bell's cellular and PCS network.

The agreement is a C$100 million increase from a C$300 million memorandum of understanding struck between Bell Mobility, a unit of BCE Mobile Communications Inc, and Nortel in April 1996. The agreement called for equipment to be provided over a five-year period.
Bell Mobility will be using Nortel's 800 and 1900 MHz CDMA infrastructure equipment, including base station radio technology, mobility services, and mobility switching.
